role: Main SwiftLint configuration used by `make lint` (Makefile:12), the pre-commit hook and the CI lint/budget gate.
toplevel: included: Emuqu/Sources, EmuquTests, 'EmuquWatch Watch App' (Emuqu/EmuquApp.swift and EmuquUITests are NOT included). excluded: Emuqu.xcodeproj, .build, build, DerivedData. opt_in_rules: first_where, force_unwrapping, implicitly_unwrapped_optional, modifier_order, implicit_optional_initialization, sorted_imports, yoda_condition. disabled_rules: trailing_whitespace, static_over_final_class (XCTestCase class overrides), redundant_discardable_let (would break `let _ =` in ViewBuilders). Thresholds: line_length 300/1800 with ignores_interpolated_strings (comment 44-68: String(localized:) keys and verbatim LLM tool-schema literals cannot be wrapped), function_body_length 100/200, function_parameter_count 7/10, type_body_length 500/1000, file_length 1000/2000, cyclomatic_complexity 15/30, large_tuple 3/5, identifier_name min 1, nesting type_level warning 2; reporter xcode. custom_rules: stacked_result_builder (error on two @ViewBuilder/@ToolbarContentBuilder attributes in a row, regex 148) and collector_forwarder_in_view (error on `collector.<one of the 19 forwarders RRCollector+Forwarders.swift declares>` in files matching `.*/Sources/(Views|Assistant/Views)/.*|.*/Sources/Export/ReportSectionPicker\.swift` — every SwiftUI view folder plus the one view outside them; a view added in another folder needs adding to that pattern — enforcing observation of sub-objects SessionState/StreamingLifecycle/MorningCoordination/DeviceStatus/ArchiveSignal instead of stale forwarders). The forwarder rule matches only the literal identifier `collector`; a view reading the same forwarder through another variable name is not caught.
